content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Overview
content_sections.text: The ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 is being conducted to engage Engineering graduates and Diploma holders for one-year apprenticeship training in Hyderabad. A total of 242 seats are available across seven engineering branches. Check the important recruitment details in the table below.

rows.details: Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India
Graduate Engineer Apprentice (GEA) and Technician (Diploma) Apprentice (TA)
B.E./B.Tech or Three-Year Engineering Diploma in the Prescribed Branches
Document Verification and Merit Based on Qualifying Examination Marks

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification was published on 24 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. Eligible candidates must submit their online applications by 13 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Document verification will be conducted from 17 to 19 December 2026, followed by the release of provisional selection offer letters through email. Apprenticeship training will begin on 1 January 2027. Important: The document verification date, reporting time, mode and venue instructions will be published on the official ECIL website. Candidates should check the website regularly for updates.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 242 apprenticeship seats have been announced under ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27. Of these, 200 seats are available for Graduate Engineer Apprentices and 42 for Technician (Diploma) Apprentices. The recruitment covers seven engineering branches, including ECE, CSE/IT, Mechanical, EEE, EIE, Civil and Chemical Engineering. ECIL has invited applications from Engineering graduates and Diploma holders in the following seven branches. The official notification provides combined seat totals for GEA and TA categories but does not specify a separate vacancy allocation for each engineering branch. Note: The 200 Graduate Engineer Apprentice seats and 42 Technician Apprentice seats are combined totals across the listed branches, not the number of seats available in each individual branch. Reservations for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and PwD candidates will be followed according to Government norms. ECIL has also stated that unfilled Graduate Apprentice seats may be filled with eligible Diploma holders and vice versa if sufficient candidates are not available or do not join.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, passing-date, age limit and apprenticeship registration requirements. Engineering graduates must possess a B.E./B.Tech qualification, while Technician Apprentice applicants must have completed a three-year Engineering Diploma in one of the prescribed branches. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 are not eligible. Yes, freshers can apply for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 if they have completed the prescribed B.E./B.Tech or three-year Engineering Diploma on or after 1 April 2024 and meet the age and other eligibility requirements. No separate prior employment experience is prescribed in the notification. However, candidates who have already completed or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in a Government, PSU or private organisation are not eligible. Important: This is a quick eligibility guide and does not confirm individual eligibility. Candidates should check the official ECIL notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Graduate Engineer Apprentice positions must have completed a B.E. or B.Tech course in one of the notified engineering branches on or after 1 April 2024. The Engineering Degree must be obtained from an AICTE-approved college or a recognised Indian university. Candidates applying for Technician (Diploma) Apprentice positions must have completed a three-year Engineering Diploma in one of the prescribed branches on or after 1 April 2024. The qualification must be obtained from an Indian institution recognised by the appropriate statutory authority. The maximum age limit for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 25 years as on 31 December 2026. The notification provides upper age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and PwD candidates. It does not separately specify a minimum age limit. ECIL provides upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates according to the official recruitment notification. Candidates claiming age relaxation must provide the applicable category or disability certificate during document verification.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification does not specify an application or examination fee for Graduate Engineer Apprentice and Technician Apprentice positions. Candidates must complete NATS registration and submit their online application through the official ECIL website. Applicants should follow the instructions displayed on the official application portal.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates under ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will receive a monthly stipend during the one-year training period. Graduate Engineer Apprentices will receive Rs.12,300 per month, while Technician (Diploma) Apprentices will receive Rs.10,900 per month. Important: These amounts are apprenticeship stipends, not regular employee salaries. ECIL has clearly stated that completing apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment or create a right to claim a job in the organisation.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The ECIL Apprentice Selection Process 2026 is based on qualifying examination marks and original document verification. Candidates will be called for document verification at CLDC-ECIL Hyderabad based on their online application details. After successful verification, selections will be made according to merit in the qualifying Engineering Degree or Diploma examination. ECIL will examine the information submitted through the online application portal to identify candidates for original document verification. Candidates called for verification must attend the prescribed venue with their original certificates and one set of photocopies. The verification process will be conducted at the Corporate Learning and Development Centre, ECIL, Hyderabad. After successful document verification, ECIL will select apprentices based on consolidated marks obtained in the qualifying B.E./B.Tech examination for Graduate Engineer Apprentices and the three-year Diploma examination for Technician Apprentices. Candidates whose results are expressed as CGPA must produce a relevant CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate issued by their college or university. ECIL will send provisional offer letters to selected candidates through email between 23 and 24 December 2026, according to the published schedule. Note: The official notification does not prescribe a written examination or interview as part of the apprenticeship selection process.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: ECIL has scheduled document verification for Graduate Engineer and Technician Apprentice applicants from 17 to 19 December 2026. Candidates shortlisted based on their online application details must attend the verification process with the required original documents and photocopies. Important: ECIL will not pay travelling allowance or daily allowance (TA/DA) to candidates attending document verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ECIL Apprentice Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates called for ECIL Apprentice Document Verification 2026 must bring their original certificates and one set of photocopies. The official notification specifies the following documents. Printed ECIL Online Application Form, Duly Signed by the Candidate Recent Colour Passport-Size Photograph Affixed to the Application NATS Registration Details or Certificate Date of Birth Proof Government-Issued Photo Identity Proof such as Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence or Passport B.E./B.Tech Consolidated Marksheet and Qualification Certificate for Graduate Apprentices Three-Year Diploma Consolidated Marksheet and Qualification Certificate for Technician Apprentices CGPA-to-Percentage Conversion Certificate, If Applicable Latest SC / ST / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS Certificate, If Applicable PwD Disability Certificate, If Applicable One Set of Photocopies of the Required Certificates Category certificates must be in the prescribed format available on the official ECIL website. Candidates should also follow any additional document instructions published for the verification schedule.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Document Verification Venue 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must attend document verification at the Corporate Learning and Development Centre in Hyderabad. The venue details provided in the official notification are listed below. Electronics Corporation of India Limited Corporate Learning & Development Centre (CLDC) Nalanda Complex, ECIL (PO) Hyderabad - 500062 Telangana Contact Numbers: 040-27186454 / 040-27182279 The exact reporting time and other instructions will be published on the official ECIL website.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice NATS Registration 2026
content_sections.text: NATS registration is mandatory for candidates applying for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026. Graduate Engineer and Technician Apprentice applicants must first register through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal. After completing NATS registration, candidates must separately submit their applications through the ECIL careers website. ECIL Apprentice 2026: NATS Registration Portal Important: Registration on NATS alone is not a completed ECIL application. The notification clearly states that only applications submitted through the official ECIL website will be accepted and considered.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The ECIL Apprentice Apply Online 2026 process is being conducted for 242 Graduate Engineer and Technician Diploma Apprentice seats. Eligible candidates must complete NATS registration and submit their applications through the official ECIL careers portal before 13 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Applicants should retain their system-generated application serial number and a printed copy of the completed form. ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Official Apply Online Website Candidates applying for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must complete two steps: registration on the NATS portal followed by the online application through the ECIL website. Follow the instructions below. Important: Candidates should preserve the system-generated application number for future correspondence. The printed application must be signed, and a recent colour passport-size photograph must be affixed before attending document verification.

content_sections.heading: ECIL Apprentice Training Duration 2026-27
content_sections.text: The ECIL apprenticeship training duration is one year, beginning on 1 January 2027. Selected candidates will undergo training at ECIL, Hyderabad, under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961. The training is intended for eligible Engineering graduates and Diploma holders. Before starting training, selected candidates must execute a Contract of Apprenticeship. The notification also specifies conditions regarding withdrawal from training and recovery of training costs and stipend in applicable circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at the Time of ECIL Apprentice Joining 2027
content_sections.text: As ECIL is a highly protected establishment, selected apprentices must produce additional certificates at the time of joining. The official notification specifies the following documents. Character / Conduct Certificate from the Institution Last Attended Police Verification Certificate from the Concerned District Police Superintendent Physical Fitness Certificate from a Civil Assistant Surgeon Candidates must complete these requirements before commencing apprenticeship training, according to the instructions issued by ECIL.

content_sections.heading: Who Is Not Eligible for ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: The ECIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification specifies eligibility restrictions relating to academic qualifications, passing date, age and previous apprenticeship training. Candidates should check these conditions before applying. Candidates who completed their qualifying Degree or Diploma before 1 April 2024. Candidates who do not possess the prescribed B.E./B.Tech or three-year Engineering Diploma in the listed branches. Candidates exceeding the prescribed age limit without an applicable relaxation. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in a Government, PSU or private organisation. Candidates who are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Act. Candidates who do not satisfy the prescribed Indian residence and qualification-recognition conditions. Candidates furnishing incorrect information or suppressing material facts may have their applications rejected. The notification also states that apprenticeship engagement may be terminated if eligibility deficiencies are discovered after training begins.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for ECIL Apprentice Applicants
content_sections.text: A total of 242 apprenticeship seats have been announced. Only candidates who passed the prescribed qualification on or after 1 April 2024 are eligible. The maximum age limit is 25 years as on 31 December 2026, before applicable relaxation. NATS registration is mandatory before submitting the ECIL application. Only applications submitted through the ECIL website will be accepted. The last date to apply online is 13 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Document verification is scheduled from 17 to 19 December 2026. Selection will be based on qualifying examination marks after successful document verification. No TA/DA will be provided for attending document verification. Previous or ongoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act makes candidates ineligible. The apprenticeship will begin on 1 January 2027 and continue for one year. Selected candidates must provide character, police verification and physical fitness certificates at joining. Completing apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment with ECIL. Any corrigendum or official update will be published only on the ECIL website.
